About these rates

These are the ordinary customs duty rates in Schedule No. 1, Part 1 of the Customs and Excise Act, as published by SARS in the tariff book dated . A rate of free means no customs duty. Rates are a percentage of the customs value unless shown otherwise: c/kg is cents per kilogram, c/li cents per litre. Unit: u = unit, kg = kilogram, li = litre, m² = square metre, m³ = cubic metre, 2u = pair.

Other duties, levies and taxes are not shown, for example ad valorem excise duty, the tyre levy and other environmental levies, anti-dumping and countervailing duties, and import VAT. Rebates, permits and the rate that applies to your particular shipment can also differ. Please confirm with SARS, or with us, before relying on a rate.
